purpose: Test the exact frozen q=84/13 model38 residual quartic with a bounded TwoCoverDescent local sieve after the full default call hit an external 504. This is a one-way exact emptiness test, not an approximation promoted as equality.

bounded_call.why: This includes a substantial finite local sieve while deliberately omitting very large local checks such as the Q(i) prime above rational 71, whose inert norm is 5041.

theorem_adapter.source: Magma V2.29 handbook, Two-Selmer Set of a Curve / TwoCoverDescent
theorem_adapter.locked_direction: Setting PrimeBound or PrimeCutoff can make the returned bounded set larger than the proper fake two-Selmer set. Therefore proper_set is a subset of bounded_set. If bounded_set is empty, proper_set is empty. If bounded_set is nonempty, no equality or rational-point conclusion is allowed.
theorem_adapter.empty_full_set_consequence: If the proper fake two-Selmer set is empty, the frozen genus-one quartic has no Q(i)-rational points.

promotion_rule: Only bounded cardinality 0 with terminal marker and exact frozen-cover sanity checks becomes a PREAUDIT no-Q(i)-point proof candidate. Any positive cardinality, timeout, runtime error, or missing marker remains OPEN.
credit: Diagnostic one-way emptiness evidence only. No rank or branch authority changes before a separate rank adapter and hostile audit.
